workloads.question: reference workload: fused attention + fused MLP vs 8 unfused kernels

decisions.reason: QK^T+softmax+PV is a reduction-free chain: fusing removes a [64x64] fp32 score tile and a [64x64] fp16 probability tile from DRAM (32.0 KB saved) plus 2 launches; smem=33.5KB regs=26 threads=64 grid=32 occupancy=0.06; 32 blocks >= 32 floor (2/SM x 16 SMs); 2 query rows/block (one warp each), K/V staged in 64-wide dimension chunks through a doubled shared buffer (no cp.async on Pascal -> next chunk issued before the current chunk's FMAs)

rejected: candidate tile 8x64 leaves only 2 accumulator registers per thread (< 4): the inner loop would be shared-memory bound; keeping 4 unfused kernels (the 512.0 KB of DRAM traffic saved does not compensate for the lost parallelism)

bias_add+relu consumes the matmul accumulator tile straight out of registers: the [64x1024] tile never reaches DRAM (512.0 KB saved) and 2 launch(es) disappear; smem=8.0KB regs=52 threads=256 grid=16 occupancy=0.50 vs unfused smem=8.0KB regs=48 threads=256 grid=16 occupancy=0.63
